purpose: OC-01..03 census: the kernel OCR compatibility adapter is a fail-closed shim preserving the legacy constructor/API while Document Intelligence admission is absent. No generic OCR model executes in Media.

behaviors: constructor preserves legacy shape but never retains or invokes the model
extract() returns PROVIDER_CLOSED / PROVIDER_NOT_STARTED / NOT_ADMITTED — never OCR text
payload reference without resolved bytes rejected; no payload/model/endpoint/storage access
cross-tenant status and idempotency payload reuse rejected
lifecycle fail-closed before start and stopped after close; cancellation is terminal

guards.noGenericOcr: extract() must not dispatch to an executor, model or remote endpoint
guards.failClosedCodesOnly: terminal results are bounded failure codes (PROVIDER_CLOSED, PROVIDER_NOT_STARTED, NOT_ADMITTED, CANCELLED) — never text output
guards.constructorCompat: legacy ctor signature preserved; service/modelRef/modelVersion validated then dropped, not invoked
